summary: Status=ERROR envelopes must report the <Errors><Error Number> number and text in the error message, not a truncated JSON dump of the body.
reason: Namecheap error envelopes often include an empty CommandResponse skeleton (e.g. DomainGetInfoResult with blank fields), and the sorted JSON body puts CommandResponse before Errors, so a 200-char truncated body hides the failure reason and reads like a successful payload.
validated_outcome: Live: get-info without DomainName now reports 'error 2010166: Parameter DomainName is Missing'; Status=OK getInfo envelopes still return success.
